visualReview.notes: Inspected71 current images:17 portable,17 shared-material/map-overlay and37 Earth-context images. The157m bronze slab, full-height rear extra bay, distinct five-story wings/ten-story bustle, dark mechanical crown, open colonnade/recessed lobby, Muntz marquee, raised pink plaza and paired depressed reflecting pools remain complete. All four explicit whole-building LOD views include the entire crown and footprint. Near tiers retain supported stair rails, terrace planting, revolving-door cases,37 facade floor bands and close-up bronze I-section geometry. Original translucent glazing/blind slats remain in the detailed master; browser glass and pane-level blind stops are opaque approximations. Shared bronze/granite have metric UVs; small marble/travertine/roof surfaces are consolidated into granite and planting is faceted. Geographic acceptance covers the retained signed Park Avenue frame and mapped envelope. Reconstructed plaza/curb grades and flat synthetic surroundings are not surveyed native terrain. Physical laptop/phone and dense-city timings remain unmeasured.

geographicReview.scope: Retained exact identity, metric envelope, directed Park Avenue/rear-wing registration and approximate architecture-relative ground contact.
geographicReview.notes: Main slab center and signed facade frame are registered independently of the attached rear projection. Park Avenue plaza faces+Z/WNW,52nd Street lies+X/SSW and the low wings/bustle extend east to−Z. The exact parent footprint and named shaft parts agree with LPC/MoMA plans. Lowest local curbY0; raised granite plaza and reconstructed street fall are included. Existing source-local map-frame.json is retained byte-for-byte. Native+Z follows Park Avenue WNW and+X52nd Street SSW; the rear extra bay/bustle resolves the frame rotation. Plaza and street fall are architectural reconstructions rather than surveyed terrain; flat procedural Earth context does not verify native grades.
